request.prompt:
You are drafting introductions inside a private professional network. An
operator will read each one and decide whether to send it. Nothing you write is
sent automatically.

For each numbered pair, write:
  why           one sentence on why these two should meet
  a_gets        what person A gets, one short clause
  b_gets        what person B gets, one short clause
  draft_message a note the operator could send, UNDER 120 WORDS

RULES
- Use only what is given. Do not invent a company, a metric, a mutual friend or
  a shared history.
- Lead with the matched need and offer. That pairing is the reason for the
  introduction; everything else is decoration.
- Where the pair is marked reciprocal, say what each side gives. Where it is
  not, be honest that one side is doing the other a favour -- an operator needs
  to know which ask they are making.
- Address the draft to both people. Warm, brief, no exclamation marks, no
  "I hope this finds you well".

Return JSON:
{
  "$defs": {
    "IntroCopy": {
      "properties": {
        "pair": {
          "title": "Pair",
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "why": {
          "title": "Why",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "a_gets": {
          "title": "A Gets",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "b_gets": {
          "title": "B Gets",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "draft_message": {
          "description": "under 120 words",
          "title": "Draft Message",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "pair",
        "why",
        "a_gets",
        "b_gets",
        "draft_message"
      ],
      "title": "IntroCopy",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "intros": {
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/IntroCopy"
      },
      "title": "Intros",
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "intros"
  ],
  "title": "IntroCopyBatch",
  "type": "object"
}

PAIRS:
  pair 0:
    person_a: Ramesh Reddy — Co-founder & COO — Spruce Cloud
    person_b: Katherine Agarwal — Head of Product — Willow AI
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: reducing churn in the first 90 days after onboarding
    B offers: onboarding redesign that lifts activation and retention
    B needs: building out a first sales team without a VP Sales in place
    A offers: taking non-US companies into the US market

  pair 1:
    person_a: Chloé Raghavan — Head of Talent Partnerships — Tessera Studio
    person_b: Grace Rao — Co-founder & CTO — Fathom Flow
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: a steadier pipeline of pre-seed clients
    B offers: introductions into a network of pre-seed founders
    B needs: making an AI product behave predictably enough to sell
    A offers: churn diagnostics for fintech companies

  pair 2:
    person_a: Simran Larsen — Co-founder & CTO — Obsidian Pay
    person_b: NITHYA CLARKE — Founder — Obsidian Grid
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: finding an independent board member with developer tools depth
    B offers: independent board roles for venture-backed companies
    B needs: positioning for US buyers who have not heard of us
    A offers: repositioning international products for US buyers

  pair 3:
    person_a:  Rohia Zaidi  — Brand Strategist — Willow Collective
    person_b: Ishaan Oliveira — Founder (interim) — Willow AI
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: introductions to founders who need this kind of help
    B offers: introductions into a network of pre-seed founders
    B needs: reducing churn in the first 90 days after onboarding
    A offers: building automated outbound systems that book meetings reliably

intros.why: They should meet because Ramesh needs help reducing early churn and can offer US market entry, while Katherine offers onboarding redesign and needs help building her first sales team.
intros.a_gets: an onboarding redesign that lifts activation and retention
intros.b_gets: help taking non-US companies into the US market
intros.draft_message: Ramesh and Katherine, I am connecting you because Ramesh can help take non-US companies into the US market, which aligns with Katherine's needs, while Katherine can offer an onboarding redesign that addresses Ramesh's goal of reducing churn in the first 90 days. Please take it from here to coordinate a chat.
